definitions.cash: Collected cash: successful, non-voided payments summed on their payment date.
definitions.transactions: Distinct sale IDs among successful, non-voided payments (not item rows).
definitions.buyers: Distinct paying members in the period.
definitions.aov: Average order value = collected cash / distinct transactions.
definitions.ticket: Average spend per buyer = collected cash / distinct buyers.
definitions.sessions: Class occurrences on the timetable in the period.
definitions.seats: Sum of class capacity across sessions.
definitions.fill: Capacity utilisation = attended seats / seats offered (aggregate, never an average of per-class rates).
definitions.conversion: Converted newcomers / newcomers (explicit Is-New labels only).
definitions.second_visit: Newcomers with at least one visit after their first.
definitions.retention: Retained members / selected-month membership-purchase cohort. Status reflects the uploaded export.
definitions.churn: Rows carrying a churned date / selected-month membership-purchase cohort. Status reflects the uploaded export.
definitions.median_life: Median days from purchase to the earlier of churn or end date (open memberships survive to snapshot).
definitions.teaching_hours: Sum of session durations, counted once per valid attended session.
definitions.lead_win: Leads with status Won / all leads.

chapters.title: Sales Performance
